OFF-HOWTO.scope: Official feature scope: care menus, 50+ characters, seven standard games, 150+ items, password, shop secret-code gesture, IR connection, Love/next generation.
OFF-HOWTO.notes: Confirms target surface and the shop 1+3 A secret-code gesture: press A at the shop, then press A quickly three more times until the owner is surprised. Does not provide exact growth math or full reward tables. The official page warns against unauthorized reproduction/distribution of website images/text/data, so firmware may use this as reference metadata only unless rights-cleared assets are supplied.

OFF-CHAR.scope: Official character presentation and visual references.
OFF-CHAR.notes: Used for names, page IDs, visual targets, proof sheets, compact 16x16 portrait rows, and 24x24 idle/main-scene C/C++ character bitmap rows. Official raster files remain analysis-only references; firmware does not load PNG/JPG/GIF resources at runtime.

OFF-NEWS.notes: Used for released password-item flow and item names.

WIKI-2024.scope: 2024 feature summary, shop, games, inventory caps, standard-game top-prize table, senior game availability.
WIKI-2024.notes: Useful when official manual is less structured.

WIKI-ITEM-2024.scope: 2024 food/item names, shop resets, storage caps, prices, secret-code items, use restrictions, and item-list liked-by-all food notes.
WIKI-ITEM-2024.notes: Used for explicit catalog overrides and Yogurt/Steak liked-by-all behavior; not official art.

WIKI-CODE-2024.scope: 2024 password and shop-secret-code values, prices, and duplicate notes.
WIKI-CODE-2024.notes: Used for seven shop A/B/C secret-code values.

WIKI-CHAR-2024.scope: Character list, care tiers, care-mistake categories, tier-to-character mappings.
WIKI-CHAR-2024.notes: Main structured growth-table source for now.

WIKI-KING-2024.scope: 2024 King donation and Super Unchikun poop-cleaning behavior.
WIKI-KING-2024.notes: Used for the 1000 Gotchi Point donation threshold, one-generation cleaner duration, and automatic poop cleanup.

WIKI-DEATH.scope: General death/starvation/sickness rules across releases, including the Connection-era direction that repeated sickness within a growth stage can lead to death.
WIKI-DEATH.notes: Used only to constrain substitute death behavior: Connection-era deaths are tied to neglect/sickness rather than old age alone. Firmware now tracks stage-local sickness count and passes away on the fourth sickness in one stage; exact 2024 thresholds and wording still need proof.

WIKI-SICKNESS.notes: Used to replace per-snack random toothache with the sourced fifteen-consecutive-snack trigger. Firmware now persists a 60 pet-minute substitute "short period" window; exact 2024 official short-period length remains unconfirmed.

WIKI-CARE.scope: Hungry/Happy care concepts, including hidden Hungry/Happy hearts on vintage/Connection-era releases.
WIKI-CARE.notes: Used for the visible four-heart plus two-hidden-heart internal meter model. Exact 2024 rerelease numeric decay windows still need confirmation.

WIKI-GOTCHI-POINTS.scope: Gotchi Point wallet behavior by Connection generation.
WIKI-GOTCHI-POINTS.notes: Used for the V2/V3 and 2024 rerelease wallet cap of 9,999 Gotchi Points.

WIKI-FAQ-2024.scope: FAQ on care mistakes, life cycle, marriage/baby, pause.

GG-GROWTH-2024.scope: Growth guide, care-mistake categories, tiers, lifespan.
GG-GROWTH-2024.notes: Cross-checks the wiki growth rules; notes sources.

GG-SPECIAL-2024.scope: Shop A/B/C special-code entry instructions and seven code values.

TAMA-PALACE-PAUSE-2024.scope: 2024 Connection pause behavior: no older-model pause feature; clock-set trick is the pause method; growth is paused while waiting for time set.
TAMA-PALACE-PAUSE-2024.notes: Used as a provisional behavior source because the official visual manual is image-only and less extractable.

CURL-V1-BASICS.scope: Legacy Plus/V1 button and clock/pause notes: B switches clock mode; A+C toggles sound in Tamagotchi mode; A+B pause applies only to American Connection, not Connexion/Plus.
CURL-V1-BASICS.notes: Helps keep regional/version differences explicit; not treated as the 2024 source of truth.
